english.note: Use 架 as the all-purpose noun for a physical stand, rack, or holder.
This is the all-purpose choice for a shelf or storage rack, including one used for books or display.
Use 架 as the all-purpose choice for a stand, rack, or holder that supports an object, such as an umbrella holder.
This is the all-purpose choice for a shelf or freestanding frame.
